reviews.text: Clean facilities, friendly staff. The dogs were happy, the owner too :)
Our dog has received good care. Nice staff
Highly recommend this doggie hotel! Our girl, Bella, is extremely anxious and needs medication twice a day. I trust the staff a great deal and know Bella is in good hands!
Both experiences very positive. Clean and friendly.
My dog ​​🐕 left very happy, I really like the facilities and the staff are super friendly and helpful at all times 😉 I am very happy with the service. …

The treatment center is easily accessible by tram! Friendly and animal-oriented care. Even the timid dog was well cared for and given everything he needed, plus space. On the way home, while running in the bushes, he had already shed his doubts from the weekend, so we both felt good.
Our dog received good and reliable care here. We will continue to bring it with us. 😊❣️ …
Good care for our dogs, but the prices are getting out of hand. High prices do drive away customers.
A truly wonderful place, with many years of experience.

The staff is very professional. The best interests of the animal come first. 24/7. They are honest if the place is not suitable for a pet; not homely but still caring and peaceful. The location is a bit off the beaten track, although close to the city center.
